author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.92 shipped: House sensor correctness fixes
why: The 10-25 audit found house-level values wrong. Three poisoned predictions pinned the consumption forecast factor at 1.3, and that factor fed the EV drain-precedence house-load estimate. Cost today showed a lifetime counter ($1,978 instead of ~$5). Idle circuits raised 583 false CRITICAL tripped-breaker rows a week, burying real alerts. Rooms also listed their own area as a borrowed scanner area.
implications: Shipped HOUSE-SENSOR-CORRECTNESS-1 at v5.103.92; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.92.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a real tripped breaker goes unalerted on a non-critical always-on circuit, or the factor drifts outside 0.8-1.2.

refs.release_notes: Forecast factor guard, cost today from EC, no delivery double count, partial periods excluded, tripped-breaker expected-on gate + critical idle windows, next-state ETA remaining time, safety available count, scanner own-area stripped.
